تمسكنت (form IIq)
# تَمَسْكَنْتُ (tamaskantu) /ta.mas.kan.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana)
# تَمَسْكَنْتَ (tamaskanta) /ta.mas.kan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana)
# تَمَسْكَنْتِ (tamaskanti) /ta.mas.kan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana)
# تَمَسْكَنَتْ (tamaskanat) /ta.mas.ka.nat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
